integrity: The complete original Michelson article was inspected for the exact first-order system, periodic and quasi-periodic solution theory, invariant tori, bounded-solution analysis, and numerical experiments. The complete 2006 same-object article was inspected through its exact equation, equilibria, periodic orbits, homoclinic/heteroclinic results, and covering-relation proof framework. A 2007 same-object bibliographic record was checked for MSC ownership. Semantic literature searches covered invariant-measure, RMS, moment, variance, conditional, and equilibrium-threshold formulations. The conditional laws, fixed RMS shell, straddling rigidity, and vertical-speed defect were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not classify existence for each parameter.
It fixes the x second moment but not the full invariant distribution or all coordinate moments.
The threshold-crossing conclusion is for nonconstant periodic orbits; arbitrary nonrecurrent complete trajectories are not classified.
The original 1986 source is month-resolved in the checked metadata; the structured full-date field uses the earliest checked day-resolved same-object source rather than inventing a day.
An equivalent short invariant-measure observation could remain in unindexed literature.
title: A stationary RMS shell and equilibrium-amplitude crossing law for the Michelson system
